g.text: Income growth offset only part of the pressure.

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #54635e

g.text: 2021 to 2023: contribution to the change in modeled income needed minus observed buyer-family median income.

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #54635e

g.text: An exact three-input Shapley calculation averages all six replacement orders so the price, rate and income contributions reconcile to the total

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #54635e

g.text: change. This is an accounting decomposition of selected inputs, not causal attribution. Rules and property-tax schedule are held fixed. Median buyer-

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #54635e

g.text: family income is contextual; a median is not a matched borrower's income. See homebuying_decomposition.csv and methodology.

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #54635e

g.text: Kevin Yamada | Canadian Household Finance | Official Canadian public sources
